methods.notes: Transparent teaching baseline; not calibrated for protein substitution chemistry.
BLOSUM62 with NCBI-style affine gaps; raw score is only comparable within this method.

significance.parameters: NCBI BLAST gapped BLOSUM62 parameters (gap open 11, extend 1): lambda=0.267, K=0.041
significance.formula: E = K*m*n*exp(-lambda*S); bits = (lambda*S - ln K)/ln 2; no edge correction

interpretation: Computational research-navigation signals; not disease, pathogenicity, or treatment predictions.
